title_ja: 雨の交差点の「また明日ね」
style: photorealistic, natural light, rainy dusk with neon reflections
setting: The Shibuya scramble crossing in Tokyo at dusk in steady rain, wet asphalt reflecting neon signs, crowds with umbrellas.

characters.sheet: a Japanese high school girl about 17 years old, soft round face, shoulder-length straight black hair with bangs, navy blazer school uniform with a red ribbon tie and a gray pleated skirt, holding a clear plastic umbrella

shots.action: Crowds with umbrellas cross the scramble crossing in the rain; the camera slowly pushes in toward A, who walks away from the camera in the middle of the crossing.
A stops, turns back over her shoulder toward the camera, smiles warmly and gives a small wave; raindrops drip from the edge of her umbrella.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.delivery: cheerful and warm, with a light laugh

assumptions_ja: 話しかける相手は見ている人（カメラ）

safety.notes_ja: 未成年のため日常的な描写に限定

style: photorealistic, natural light, bright summer afternoon
setting: The wooden veranda (engawa) of an old Japanese house on a sunny summer afternoon, a green garden beyond.

characters.sheet: a red-and-white Shiba Inu dog with a fox-like face, upright triangular ears, cream cheeks and chest, a tightly curled tail, wearing a thin red collar

shots.camera: static with a very slow push-in
shots.action: A lies on the sunlit veranda and happily munches a triangular slice of red watermelon on a small plate, juice on its muzzle.

shots.camera: rack focus from the wind chime to the dog
shots.action: A glass wind chime with a paper strip hangs from the eaves; a gentle breeze sways it and it rings once. Focus shifts to A, who lifts its head and perks its ears.
sfx: one clear glass wind chime ring, chirin

assumptions_ja: 夏らしさとしてセミの声を追加

style: photorealistic, warm tungsten light, steamy kitchen
setting: The open kitchen behind the wooden counter of a small Japanese ramen shop at night, big pots of boiling water.

characters.sheet: a Japanese ramen chef in his 50s, square face with a short stubble beard, buzz-cut black hair, white twisted headband, black T-shirt, dark navy apron, thick forearms
characters.voice: loud, gruff, energetic middle-aged male voice

shots.action: A's hand yanks a deep mesh noodle strainer out of boiling water, steam bursting up.
A snaps the strainer down twice with a powerful shake, water flying off, then looks up at the customer with a big grin and shouts with his mouth wide open.
sfx: sharp water flicks from the strainer

assumptions_ja: 尺は10秒（セリフが短く動作も1つのため）

style: 3D animated feature film style, soft morning light
setting: A small cozy home and the quiet residential street outside it on a sunny morning.

characters.sheet: an anthropomorphic calico kitten who walks upright, white fur with large orange and black patches, a black patch over the left ear, an orange patch around the right eye, big green eyes, small pink nose

shots.action: In a small bed, A wakes up as the alarm rings, stretches its arms and gives a big yawn.
sfx: alarm clock ringing then clicked off

shots.action: At a bathroom sink, A brushes its teeth in front of a mirror, foam on its mouth.

wardrobe.A: white shirt, yellow school hat and a red school backpack

shots.action: A runs out the front door and down the street toward school, backpack bouncing.

assumptions_ja: 人のように立って暮らす猫として3Dアニメ風にした
服はパジャマから通学服に着替える
毛の模様（左耳が黒、右目まわりが茶）を全カットで固定

style: photorealistic, night, colorful firework light flickering on faces
setting: A summer festival at night by a riverbank, paper lanterns and glowing food stalls, large fireworks bursting in the sky.

characters.sheet: a Japanese young woman in her early 20s, gentle oval face, black hair tied up in a bun with a red flower hair ornament, navy yukata with white morning glory pattern and a red obi
a Japanese young man in his early 20s, slim face, short black hair, charcoal gray striped yukata with a black obi

shots.action: A and B stand side by side among the festival crowd, seen from behind, and look up as big fireworks bloom over the river.
Their faces glow with changing colors from the fireworks. The woman in the navy yukata (A) speaks first, still looking up; a beat later the man in the gray yukata (B) nods and answers.

assumptions_ja: 二人は20代前半の女性と男性（声を分けやすくするため）

style: photorealistic, soft morning sunlight, calm and clean
setting: The entrance of a small new neighborhood shop with a white noren curtain on a quiet street on a clear morning.

characters.sheet: a Japanese shop owner, a man in his 40s, kind face, short neat black hair, crisp white shirt with rolled sleeves, dark green apron

shots.action: A new light wooden signboard beside the entrance, facing the camera, with four large black brush-calligraphy characters written vertically: 「本日開店」.
A stands beside the 「本日開店」 sign, hands together in front, bows deeply at about 45 degrees, holds the bow for two seconds, then straightens up with a gentle smile.

assumptions_ja: 店の種類は決めず、のれんのある小さな店
